data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.Create.Description
data.value: Create a source snapshot in an isolated workspace. New modules are generated from the installed local template; existing modules are copied before editing. Target source is never written.

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.Read.Description
data.value: Read a text file and SHA-256 from an isolated workspace module; target source and paths outside the workspace are inaccessible.

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.Write.Description
data.value: Atomically write a code file inside the isolated workspace. Project, NuGet, MSBuild, and application configuration files cannot be modified.

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.Validate.Description
data.value: Validate the isolated module path and direct Senparc.Web reference to the source project, then generate a controlled diff summary.

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.StartPreview.Description
data.value: Give the cleaned isolated workspace copy to Sandbox for build and execution; fail safely when Sandbox is unavailable without falling back to the main site process.

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.Status.Description
data.value: Return isolated workspace, diff, validation, Sandbox preview, and human approval status.

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.RequestMerge.Description
data.value: Freeze the current isolated workspace diff and request administrator approval. The target source is not written.

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.Discard.Description
data.value: Stop the related Sandbox preview and reclaim the isolated workspace without modifying target source.
